description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs, and gain a Section 232 steel component the witness never had.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The pre-fix module withheld the Brazil IEEPA surcharge only from the witness's single aluminum exemplar line (`not entry_is_line_b`) instead of from the whole Section 232 aluminum class that HTS 9903.01.77's carve-out to 9903.85.02 names, so the +40% Brazil duty was over-applied to this chapter's aluminum entries.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 84: Brazil gate `not entry_is_line_b` -> `not entry_is_section_232_aluminum` in `ieepa_component_rate` and `ieepa_component_rate_with_declared_exceptions` (fidelity), plus citation-only re-grounding of `ch88_s232_steel_heading_rate` / `section_232_steel_component_rate` atoms from 9903.81.87/.88 to 9903.82.02 (mechanical). No other change in the diff. Provisions read once, under index 84.
triage.verifier_justification: The diff changes encoded meaning in both IEEPA rules: the Brazil +40% carve-out gate moves from the witness exemplar-line flag `entry_is_line_b` to the class-membership input `entry_is_section_232_aluminum`, so the population the surcharge is withheld from changes from one exemplar HTS line to the whole Section 232 aluminum class. The cited authority is class-scoped — the rule's own proof atom excerpt reads "The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02", and 9903.85.02 resolves in the pinned corpus to "products of aluminum provided for in the tariff headings or subheadings enumerated in subdivision (g) of note 19" (9903.01.83 likewise carves out "articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum") — so pre-fix the exception could essentially never fire for a real chapter-88 entry and the +40% was over-applied. This is not merely new coverage: the module's unchanged summary already declares "section-232 aluminum/steel ... identifiers are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation" and only "Beer/section-338 keeps entry_is_line_d", and `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` was already used in the same pre-fix file for `section_232_aluminum_component_rate`, so the exemplar gate was a residual scope error, not the declared interface. Kind is wrong_entity_or_scope rather than untraceable_branch because the branch and its proof atom are source-grounded and retained; only the population it applies to was wrong.
